name: Eduardo "Eddie" De La Riva
office: City of Maywood, Member of the City Council

items.text: Eduardo 'Eddie' De La Riva is an incumbent member of the Maywood City Council. He was elected in 2013 and became mayor in 2015. In 2017, he expressed confidence that federal threats against sanctuary cities would be defeated in court. In 2022, he introduced a motion to seek a Climate Action, Adaptation, and Resilience Plan for the city.
